bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. LANCE:
H.R. 1329.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 1: The Congress shall have
Power to lay and collect Taxes, Duties, Imposts and Excises,
to pay the Debts and provide for the common Defence and
general Welfare of the United States; but all Duties, Imposts
and Excises shall be uniform throughout the United States.
[Page H2267]

bill.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to make the credit for research activities permanent and to provide an increase in such credit for taxpayers whose gross receipts are predominantly from domestic production activities.
